**Finding: compliant (rule inapplicable) — no redline proposed.**

The RENEWAL rule has no purchase on this agreement:

- **No auto-renewal mechanic exists.** Section 12.1 (p0485) sets a single, self-executing term running from the Effective Date until expiry of Sanofi's payment obligations under Article IX or the Profit/Loss Share Agreement, whichever is later. I read the whole of Article XII and found no renewal term, no evergreen language, and no non-renewal notice requirement.
- **Searches confirm absence.** "automatically renew", "unless either Party gives notice", "renewal term", "successive", "extend the Term", and price-increase patterns return no relevant hits. The only "renewal"/"non-renewal" references are patent prosecution renewals (p0098) and the insurance non-renewal notice (p0603) — neither is a term-extension mechanic.
- **No parameter can breach.** With no notice window, the >90-day walk-away and ≤60-day fallback thresholds cannot be computed or failed; there is no multi-year auto-renewal and no renewal-linked uplift to cap.
- **The rule's policy goals are already met in our favour.** Section 12.2(a)(i) gives Sanofi termination for convenience, in whole or country-by-country/Product-by-Product, plus termination rights for RevMed's change of control and for safety. Exit is unilateral and at our discretion, not gated behind a renewal deadline.

I classified this as compliant rather than "missing" because a usable term clause does exist, and grafting an auto-renewal-with-opt-out construct onto a collaboration and licence built around Royalty Term expiry would introduce an extension mechanic we do not want — flagging it would work against our own position.
